proves.claim: ineligibleReleaseIds, parkedClaims and refusesFamilyRelaxation read a seat's events through the (event_by, event_kind, event_id) index, never scanning events or walking the seat's events by time.

store.io-cooldown.seat-kind-reads-seek.why: Without this test next's cooldown reads walked every event of the seat and filtered by kind, over a second for the coordinator's 181,874 events at load (20 Nov).

proves.claim: with 18,187 events of other kinds on a seat, each cooldown read stays under 20 ms and within 2x of a seat with 10.

store.io-cooldown.cooldown-flat-with-his.why: Without this test the cooldown reads grew with each seat's history, so a speed budget on a fresh fixture proved nothing about long-lived seats.
